post.description:
Send a prompt to the current model. The answer arrives later: poll `Location`.

A prompt longer than the configured maximum is a 422 (`PROMPT_TOO_LONG`).

get.description:
One of your own jobs, optionally waiting for it to finish.

The answer is always 200 with the job's state at that moment: pending if the
wait ended without a result. Another user's job is reported as not found.

parameters.name: wait_seconds

schema.description: Wait up to this many seconds for a pending job to finish (long polling). Capped at the server's maximum (25 by default); 0 reads at once.

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description:
Every error code a client can receive. Values are part of the API: never rename one.

A new, more specific code is added here and passed at the raise site, for
example `NotFoundError(code=ErrorCode.USER_NOT_FOUND)`.

ModelChange.title: ModelChange
ModelChange.description:
The model new prompt jobs are sent to. It must be one of the allowed models,
checked by the service.

ModelSettings.title: ModelSettings
ModelSettings.description: The current model and the models it may be switched to.

PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange
PasswordChange.description:
A new password for the current user, confirmed with the current one.

The policy check needs the account's username and email, so it runs in the
service, not here.

Permission.title: Permission
Permission.description: A named capability that an endpoint can require.

PromptCreate.title: PromptCreate

PromptJobErrorCode.title: PromptJobErrorCode
PromptJobErrorCode.description:
Every value a job's `error_code` can take, for clients and the API schema.

The union of the LLM service's `JobErrorCode` and the backend's own
`BackendJobErrorCode`; a unit test keeps it complete.

PromptJobStatus.title: PromptJobStatus
PromptJobStatus.description: A job is pending until a result, a failure or a timeout makes it terminal.
